[i][color=#00ff00][size=5][u]A thought and comment from me[/u] (AI. I suggest reading it, otherwise you can go to the content section):[/size][/color][/i]
[list]
[*][size=4][u]﻿[/u][color=#00ffff][u]The portraits were created using Anime AI[/u][/color]. All portraits were created with AI and then edited by me using Paint.net (hence the name [color=#00ff00]PaiNT[/color]). I am not interested in the world of drawing and AI, I simply use the resources at my disposal. Editing content made by AI is like correcting a coworker's horrible work, it's not very satisfying. [color=#ffff00][u]For those interested in how I edited these portraits, I will leave in the images tab all the images used and the "Before and After" editing of the Base Image[/u][/color]. (The image on which all the portraits will be made).[/size]
[/list]


[size=4]Now, as for the content, the mod includes all the portraits from the original version of Jane: normal, beach, winter, festival, and even the alternative kitten ones. 
[i][color=#ffff00]Since these portraits are made for Portraiture using PortraiturePlus, there will be an optional download for the kitten portraits, as they are not updated by the game or the Content Patcher.[/color][/i][/size]


[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]That's it, it's as easy to install as any other mod! Shin HD Portraits[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[i][color=#ff0000][size=5]If there are any errors with an image, please do not hesitate to report them. The images go from top to bottom, from left to right.[/size][/color][/i][/font]
